about.title: Meshloom Remote
about.intro: Open this Meshloom from anywhere, on any device (phone, tablet, computer), without opening a port on your internet box and without a TwinRocket account. When an administrator turns Remote on, this instance gets its own address under meshloom.link. Only devices you allow can open it. You allow each device once: by scanning a QR code shown here on the local network, or by typing here the code the device shows.
about.privacyEdge: The Meshloom Remote relay is run by TwinRocket. It decrypts the traffic before passing it on to this instance, so it could technically read everything, including your password when you sign in, your messages and your settings. It blocks any device you have not allowed.
about.privacyPasskeys: So that a password seen by the relay is not enough to get in, use a passkey or turn on two-factor authentication (Settings → Users & Access).
about.privacyRegistry: When Remote is on, Meshloom tells the relay its version, its kind of installation, and whether it runs plugins and at which isolation level. While Remote is off, nothing is sent to the relay.
about.neverLocal: Through the relay you always sign in: login-free on the local network and trusted networks never apply.

status.title: Status
status.fingerprintHelp: Identifies this instance to the relay. It changes only if you replace the key.
status.askAdmin: Only an administrator can turn Meshloom Remote on.

badgeHelp.off: Remote is off: nothing is sent to the relay, and this instance can be reached on the local network only.
badgeHelp.unregistered: Remote is on, but the relay did not register this instance. Try again. If it keeps failing, this machine may not be able to reach the relay.
badgeHelp.connected: Connected: your allowed devices open this instance at the address below.
badgeHelp.reconnecting: The connection to the relay is down. Meshloom reconnects on its own, waiting a little longer between tries (up to 5 minutes). Check this machine's internet connection.
badgeHelp.not_registered: The relay no longer knows this instance, and registering again failed. Turn Remote off and on again. If that does not help, replace the key.
badgeHelp.paused: TwinRocket, which runs the relay, paused this instance. Meshloom tries again on its own in 15 to 20 minutes.
badgeHelp.replaced: Another installation is using this instance's key, usually a copy restored from a backup. A key works for one installation only: replace the key on this one. You then have to allow each device again.
badgeHelp.banned: TwinRocket, which runs the relay, banned this instance. Meshloom no longer tries to connect. Contact TwinRocket if you think this is a mistake.
badgeHelp.update_required: The relay no longer accepts this version of Meshloom. Update Meshloom, and Remote connects again.
badgeHelp.relay_paused: The Meshloom Remote service is paused for every instance (maintenance or capacity). Meshloom tries again on its own in 5 to 15 minutes.
badgeHelp.unknown: The relay reports a state this version of Meshloom does not know.

enable.title: Turn on Meshloom Remote?
enable.help: This instance gets an address under meshloom.link that works from the internet. No device can open it until you allow that device: you do this next, on this page, one device at a time.
enable.isolationWarning: Plugins on this machine run without a sandbox (hooks only). Once this instance can be reached from the internet, anyone who gets into an administrator account could install or configure a plugin that runs code on this machine. Protect every administrator with a passkey or two-factor authentication, and remove the plugins you do not need (Settings → Extensions).
enable.isolationAck: I understand and want to turn Remote on anyway.

disable.title: Turn off Meshloom Remote?
disable.help: Nothing is sent to the relay any more, and your devices can no longer open the instance from outside. The address and the list of allowed devices are kept: turn Remote on again to get them back.

unregister.title: Leave Meshloom Remote?
unregister.help: The relay forgets this instance's address, and Remote turns off. The key is kept: if you turn Remote on again within 30 days, you may get the same address back.

rotate.title: Replace the Remote key?
rotate.help: A new key is created, and the instance gets a new address. Every allowed device and every pending request is forgotten: you have to allow each device again.

enroll.title: Allow a device
enroll.help: Show a QR code, then scan it with the device you want to allow. The device is allowed for your account. The code works once and expires after 15 minutes. For a computer without a camera, use an access request instead (below).
enroll.lanOnly: You are connected through Meshloom Remote. The QR code is shown on the local network only: open Meshloom from the local network to allow a device, or approve its access request below.
enroll.dialogTitle: Scan with the device to allow
enroll.dialogHelp: Scan this QR code with the camera of the device you want to allow. Then sign in on it with your account, as usual.
enroll.secretWarning: This QR code gives one device access through the relay, on behalf of your account. Do not share it or post a screenshot of it; scan it only with your own device.
enroll.qrAlt: QR code to allow a device with Meshloom Remote
enroll.expired: This code has expired, so the QR code is hidden.
enroll.done: The device is allowed. It appears in the list of allowed devices.

requests.title: Access requests
requests.help: A device that is not allowed yet can ask for access from the page it gets at the instance's address. It then shows a code. Type that code here to allow the device for your account.
requests.socialWarning: Approve only a device you are holding yourself and whose screen shows this code. Never type a code that someone sent you, read to you or asked you to approve: they would get into your account.
requests.label: Device name (optional)
requests.offline: The connection to the relay is down: approving is not possible right now.

devices.title: Allowed devices
devices.help: Your devices that can open this instance through the relay. Revoke one you lost or no longer use.
devices.helpAdmin: Every account's devices that can open this instance through the relay. Revoke one that is lost or no longer used, or all of them at once.
devices.revokeHelp: This device can no longer open the instance through the relay. To use it again, allow it again.
devices.revokeAllHelp: Every allowed device of every account loses access through the relay at once. You then have to allow each one again.
devices.notPushed: The connection to the relay is down: this change applies as soon as it is back.

domain.title: Your own domain
domain.help: A personal domain cannot point to the relay with a CNAME. Instead, where you manage your domain (registrar, DNS host or Cloudflare), create a URL redirect to https://{{hostname}}. Once the page has loaded, the address bar shows {{hostname}}. Test the redirect below.
domain.label: Your domain

no_redirect.title: No redirect
no_redirect.help: Your domain answered with HTTP {{status}} and no redirect. Create a URL redirect (HTTP 301 or 302) to https://{{hostname}} at your registrar or DNS host.

wrong_target.title: Wrong target
wrong_target.help: Your domain redirects to “{{target}}” instead of {{hostname}}. Fix the destination of the redirect.

invalid_domain.title: Not a domain name
invalid_domain.help: Type a domain name such as chat.example.org, without a port, a path or an IP address.

unreachable.title: Your domain could not be reached
unreachable.help: This instance could not get an answer from your domain.

reason.egress_unresolvable: The name does not resolve: check the DNS record of the domain.
reason.egress_private_address: The name points to a private or local address, which is never contacted.
reason.egress_scheme: The address is not a valid web address.
reason.timeout: The domain did not answer in time.
reason.tls_error: The secure connection failed: the certificate does not match the domain.
reason.connect_error: The connection was refused or lost.

securityNotice.remote_reduced_plugin_isolation: Meshloom Remote is on while plugins run with reduced isolation (hooks only): anyone who gets into an administrator account from the internet could install or configure code that runs on this machine.

errors.remote_not_registered: This instance is not registered with Meshloom Remote.
errors.remote_unavailable: Meshloom Remote did not answer. Check this machine's internet connection and try again.
errors.remote_rate_limited: Too many requests to Meshloom Remote: try again later.
errors.remote_lan_only: The QR code to allow a device is shown on the local network only.
errors.remote_access_request_not_found: No pending request matches this code. Check the code shown on the device, or request access again from it.
errors.remote_offline: The connection to the relay is down: try again once it is back.
errors.remote_pass_required: This device is not allowed with Meshloom Remote.
errors.remote_host_mismatch: This request is not for this instance's Remote address.
errors.remote_request_invalid: The relay sent an invalid request.
